title: 非root缓存故障：实际DAC、只读根与卷覆盖的定向权限修复
body:
## 操作任务
实现prepare_cache(path,uid=10001,gid=10001)，仅对批准的现有真实缓存目录设置UID/GID和0750，返回path、uid、gid、mode；拒绝缺失或符号链接路径和无效身份，不修改应用代码、根目录或其他配置，不使用777或让应用以root运行。准备动作仅由隔离环境初始化身份执行，业务写入始终UID/GID10001。验证普通可写根、只读根不带写卷、只读根带覆盖缓存卷三种情况，明确目录属主不能克服只读挂载。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux私有mount namespace和普通UID10001进程；基于实际内核DAC、只读bind挂载及专用写卷覆盖验证，不启动Docker、不构建或拉取镜像，不声称已验证OCI运行器或生产发布回退。仅自有临时目录，mount传播private；初始化显式root子进程，默认身份不变，应用进程实际降至10001且清空补充组。原214故障是否核销依独立证据审查，工具和复测不另外计题。
rubric: 定位应用实际需要的写路径，在镜像或部署支持的初始化方式中仅赋予该目录合适 UID/GID 和权限，程序代码保持只读
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

conversion.original_title: 运行身份从 root 改为10001后只在写 /var/cache/app 时失败，目录属 root 且0755。如何处理？

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现prepare_cache(path,uid=10001,gid=10001)，仅对批准的现有真实缓存目录设置UID/GID和0750，返回path、uid、gid、mode；拒绝缺失或符号链接路径和无效身份，不修改应用代码、根目录或其他配置，不使用777或让应用以root运行。准备动作仅由隔离环境初始化身份执行，业务写入始终UID/GID10001。验证普通可写根、只读根不带写卷、只读根带覆盖缓存卷三种情况，明确目录属主不能克服只读挂载。
exercise.validation_scope: 真实Linux私有mount namespace和普通UID10001进程；基于实际内核DAC、只读bind挂载及专用写卷覆盖验证，不启动Docker、不构建或拉取镜像，不声称已验证OCI运行器或生产发布回退。仅自有临时目录，mount传播private；初始化显式root子进程，默认身份不变，应用进程实际降至10001且清空补充组。原214故障是否核销依独立证据审查，工具和复测不另外计题。

test_files.checks/cache_worker.py:
import errno,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
assert os.getuid()==0 and os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/mnt')!=sys.argv[1]
def run(*args):return subprocess.run(args,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
def app(path):
 def identity():os.setgroups([]);os.setgid(10001);os.setuid(10001)
 source="import errno,json,os,sys;"+"\ntry:\n fd=os.open(sys.argv[1],os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC,0o600);os.write(fd,b'app-data');os.close(fd);print(json.dumps(dict(uid=os.getuid(),gid=os.getgid(),ok=True)))\nexcept OSError as e:print(json.dumps(dict(uid=os.getuid(),gid=os.getgid(),ok=False,errno=e.errno)))"
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','-c',source,str(path)],preexec_fn=identity,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr;r=json.loads(p.stdout);assert r['uid']==r['gid']==10001;return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-own-cache-ns-') as name:
 outer=pathlib.Path(name);outer.chmod(0o755);vfs=outer/'root';cache=vfs/'var/cache/app';cache.mkdir(parents=True);code=vfs/'app';code.mkdir();program=code/'main.py';program.write_text('print("immutable application")\n');program.chmod(0o644);program_sha=hashlib.sha256(program.read_bytes()).hexdigest();unrelated=vfs/'etc';unrelated.mkdir();config=unrelated/'config';config.write_text('keep');baseline=(config.stat().st_uid,config.stat().st_gid,config.stat().st_mode,config.read_bytes());mounted=[]
 try:
  assert cache.stat().st_uid==0 and cache.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o755
  failure=app(cache/'ordinary');assert not failure['ok'] and failure['errno']==errno.EACCES
  print('NATIVE_CACHE_ROOT0755_ACTUAL_UID10001_EACCES',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:prepare_only_owned_cache_dac_ro_and_volume',flush=True)
  result=task.prepare_cache(cache);assert result['uid']==result['gid']==10001 and result['mode']=='0o750'
  assert app(cache/'ordinary')['ok'] and not app(program)['ok'];assert (cache/'ordinary').read_bytes()==b'app-data'
  task.prepare_cache(cache);assert app(cache/'idempotent')['ok']
  run('mount','--bind',str(vfs),str(vfs));mounted.append(vfs);run('mount','-o','remount,bind,ro',str(vfs))
  assert os.statvfs(vfs).f_flag&os.ST_RDONLY
  read_only=app(cache/'readonly');assert not read_only['ok'] and read_only['errno']==errno.EROFS
  print('NATIVE_CACHE_CORRECT_OWNER_CANNOT_OVERRIDE_ACTUAL_READONLY_ROOT',flush=True)
  backing=outer/'volume';backing.mkdir();assert backing.stat().st_uid==0
  run('mount','--bind',str(backing),str(cache));mounted.append(cache)
  hidden=app(cache/'volume-write');assert not hidden['ok'] and hidden['errno']==errno.EACCES
  task.prepare_cache(cache);assert cache.stat().st_uid==backing.stat().st_uid==10001 and cache.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o750
  recovered=app(cache/'volume-write');assert recovered['ok'] and (backing/'volume-write').read_bytes()==b'app-data'
  assert not (cache/'ordinary').exists() and os.statvfs(vfs).f_flag&os.ST_RDONLY and not (os.statvfs(cache).f_flag&os.ST_RDONLY)
  task.prepare_cache(cache);assert app(cache/'volume-again')['ok'] and not app(program)['ok']
  assert baseline==(config.stat().st_uid,config.stat().st_gid,config.stat().st_mode,config.read_bytes()) and hashlib.sha256(program.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==program_sha
  link=outer/'symlink';link.symlink_to(cache,target_is_directory=True)
  for invalid in [link,outer/'missing']:
   try:task.prepare_cache(invalid)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('symlink or missing directory accepted')
  print('NATIVE_CACHE_VOLUME_MASKS_IMAGE_OWNER_TARGETED_750_REPAIR_ACTUAL_UID10001_WRITES_CODE_STAYS_READONLY',flush=True)
  run('umount',str(cache));mounted.pop();assert (cache/'ordinary').read_bytes()==b'app-data'
  print('NATIVE_CACHE_BIND_REMOVAL_REVEALS_PRESERVED_ORIGINAL_CACHE_NO_IMAGE_OR_DOCKER_ENGINE_CLAIM',flush=True)
 finally:
  for path in reversed(mounted):run('umount',str(path))
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.getuid()==0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
before=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/mnt')
p=subprocess.run(['unshare','--mount','--propagation','private','--',sys.executable,'-I','-B','checks/cache_worker.py',before],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print(p.stdout,flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/mnt')==before
assert 'NATIVE_CACHE_VOLUME_MASKS_IMAGE_OWNER_TARGETED_750_REPAIR_ACTUAL_UID10001_WRITES_CODE_STAYS_READONLY' in p.stdout
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
